office_name: County Judge + Sheriff + County Clerk + District Clerk + Tax Assessor-Collector
notes: Five countywide elected offices share the Galveston County boundary: County Judge Mark A. Henry; Sheriff Jimmy Fullen; County Clerk Dwight D. Sullivan; District Clerk John D. Kinard; and Tax Assessor-Collector Cheryl E. Johnson. The County Treasurer office was constitutionally abolished effective January 1, 2024; treasury functions are now a division of the County Clerk, so no vacancy or current-holder record is created. Census GEOID 48167.
